# Intervention-specific activation witnesses — v1

2026-11-14. Current owner interpretation of3418a134/1b5e8994: held-side nonactivation applies to SIDE-DEPENDENT shocks, not to interventions whose mechanism prevents holdings or changes all fill costs. Before retained/scientific values; SAME PR132 source review/producer. No criterion weakening, moved shock or financial run.

BASE and highercost baseline are declared baseline cases and need no held-side shock activation. Source/technical/valuation failures still remain their own statuses, never disguised as nonactivation.

LOCATE_DENIED denies every actual eligible proposed NEW short increment across all47 formations, including first entry. Candidate path activates on at least one valid nonzero requested incremental short with its identity/cap/formation/event, whose scenario locate is denied and whose paired new-risk increments are cancelled. Persist proposed quantities, denial and zero new-risk submissions/fills as mechanism evidence. SUCCESSFUL denial leaving no long/short cannot turn the path NOT_ACTIVATED. No actual requested short at all=>NOT_ACTIVATED, required coverage incomplete absent controlling known failure. HALF_LONG/CASH have no short attempts and no fake denial; global pathactivation comes from candidate, per-account affected/noapplicable status remains separate. Denial is scenario evidence, not observed loan inventory or an execution.

ADVERSE_100BPS applies fixed bid99/100 / ask101/100 to EVERY positive actual candidate/control fill over the whole declared phase, initial and EXIT included, not only one pre-shock held issuer. Candidate path activates on at least one actual candidate fill with exact reference/sidequote/fill/fee identity showing the selected adverse terms. No pre-shock held-side requirement; no fills=>NOT_ACTIVATED. Do not move the price-shock index or synthesize fill solely to activate. Per-control actual fill/cost effect is independently reported; no duplicate spread charge. This explicitly resolves any earlier generic shock-index wording for this all-fill cost intervention, before dependent values.

BORROW_50 rate change remains effective at fixed shock event onward. Activation requires candidate's positive actual short-notional/calendar accrual base under the changed rate after that event, at the event or later; need not select a held issuer for a common rate rule. Record exact interval/base/rate witness; no new short from an invented locate just to create activation. No applicable positive exposure=>NOT_ACTIVATED.

MAINTENANCE_160 change remains effective at fixed shock event onward. Activation requires a candidate actual positive short-liability checkpoint evaluated under new restriction/equity rates OR a valid nonzero proposed short increment evaluated against those changed requirements. Save required/counterpart old/new coefficient/test operands and actual admission/mark identity; no requirement that it pass or execute. An adverse requirement that correctly blocks a short is still activated, not omitted. No applicable checkpoint/request=>NOT_ACTIVATED.

Issuer-dependent SHORT_1P5, SHORT_2, SHORT_5 and RECALL_BLACKOUT2 require actual candidate short holdings immediately BEFORE the fixed shock event to bind the short issuer. LONG_0P7_SHORT_1P5 and LONG_0P7_SHORT_1P5_RECALL require both actual long and short at that exact prefix; missing side=>NOT_ACTIVATED for the whole declared joint intervention, never a redefined one-sided case. Use SAME exact selected issuer(s) and prebound event for every control, with prefix proof and unchanged original source. No shifted date, synthetic pre-position or control-specific favorable issuer. All filled/partial sides and unsupported cases remain represented.

Required candidate survival and knownfailure-over-unavailable/required-incomplete rules remain unchanged. Activated is coverage, not survivalPASS, economic usefulness, source/loan validity or statistical independence. Two diagnostic destruction paths remain diagnostic. Preserve every source/unfinalized path; do not retrospectively relabel a result to support. Add the appropriate attempt/fill/interval/checkpoint or held-prefix witness and saved-verifier join in SAME producer and technical QA; no new method wave, retained values/call, reservation or48account allocation.
